s: The de-facto workflow orchestrator expressing pipelines as DAGs of tasks with retries, schedules, and backfills.
w: Scheduler parses DAG files, enqueues ready tasks respecting dependencies; executors (Celery/K8s) run them on workers; metadata DB tracks state/history. Tasks retry with configurable policies; sensors wait on external conditions; backfill commands replay historical windows. UI shows tree/graph/gantt views for ops.
use: Multi-stage ELT orchestrating extract->load->dbt->quality checks nightly
ML retraining cadences (features -> train -> evaluate -> promote)
avoid: Massive parallel task counts (thousands) - scheduler chokes; consider Dagster/Prefect/argo
pits: Scheduler death spiral from dynamic DAG generation - cap DAG count, static definitions
Tasks holding DB connections during sleeps - use sensors properly
tips: Idempotent+partitioned tasks mantra for reliable backfills
